beginner.title: Welcome to MineAI IDE
beginner.description: Learn the basics of Minecraft modding with AI assistance
steps: Open the Dashboard and explore the interface
Create your first project using 'New Project' wizard
Ask the AI assistant for help with basic mod elements
Build and test your mod with one click

beginner.title: Create Your First Custom Item
beginner.description: Learn to create a simple custom item with texture
steps: Use AI: 'create a ruby sword with custom texture'
Review generated Java code in the editor
Drag and drop your texture file

intermediate.title: Blockbench Model Creation
steps: Import external .bbmodel files or create from scratch
Export and integrate with your mod
